ImageProcessor.load_image:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Opens an image file from the given path using Pillow and stores the resulting Image object as an instance attribute." load_image]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> image_path </REF>: str | pathlib.Path | file-like object "File-system path or file-like object pointing to the image to be opened; passed directly to Image.open without transformation"
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Call Image.open with image_path to obtain a lazily-loaded PIL Image object whose concrete subclass is determined by the file format detected at runtime RESULT pil_image]
            [COMMAND Assign pil_image to self.image, creating or overwriting the instance attribute so all other methods on self can access the image through self.image RESULT self.image]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: image_path is None]
        [LOG "Image.open received None as the path argument"]
        [THROW AttributeError | TypeError "Raised by Image.open when image_path is None; self.image is left unset or retains its prior value"]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: The file at image_path does not exist on disk]
        [LOG "Image.open could not locate the file at the provided path"]
        [THROW FileNotFoundError "Raised by Image.open when the path resolves to a non-existent file; self.image is left unset or retains its prior value"]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: The file exists but is not a recognized image format]
        [LOG "Image.open identified the file but could not match it to a supported format"]
        [THROW PIL.UnidentifiedImageError "Raised by Image.open when the file content does not match any registered Pillow decoder; self.image is left unset or retains its prior value"]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
ImageProcessor.save_image:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Saves the instance's image to the specified file path if an image is present, silently skipping the operation when no image exists." save_image]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> save_path </REF>: string "The file system path where the image should be saved"
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check whether self.image is truthy (non-None, non-falsy); if true, call self.image.save(save_path) to write the image to disk at the given path; if false, skip silently with no action taken RESULT save_result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: self.image is falsy (None, empty, or any other falsy value)]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Skip the save operation entirely; no method is called and no error is raised RESULT no_op]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
ImageProcessor.resize_image:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Resizes the stored image to the specified width and height dimensions, but only if an image is currently set." resize_image]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> width </REF>: int "Target width in pixels for the resized image"
        <REF> height </REF>: int "Target height in pixels for the resized image"
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check whether self.image is truthy (i.e., a non-None, non-falsy image object is currently stored) RESULT image_exists]
            [COMMAND If image_exists is true, call self.image.resize with the tuple (width, height) to produce a new image object scaled to the given dimensions, then assign the result back to self.image, replacing the previous value RESULT self.image]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: self.image is falsy (None or another falsy value) at the time of the call]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Skip the resize operation entirely; self.image retains its current falsy value and no side effects occur RESULT no_op]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
ImageProcessor.rotate_image:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Rotates the instance's loaded image by the specified number of degrees, replacing the stored image with the rotated result, and silently skips the operation if no image is currently loaded." rotate_image]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> degrees </REF>: number "The angle in degrees by which to rotate the image"
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check whether self.image is truthy (i.e., a non-None, non-empty image object is currently loaded on the instance) RESULT image_present]
            [COMMAND If image_present is true, call the rotate method on self.image passing degrees as the rotation angle, then assign the returned new image object back to self.image, replacing the previous reference RESULT self.image]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: self.image is falsy (None, empty, or any other falsy value) at the time of the call]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Skip the rotation entirely and return without performing any operation or signaling the caller RESULT no_op]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
ImageProcessor.adjust_brightness:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Applies a brightness adjustment to the current image using PIL's ImageEnhance.Brightness, replacing self.image with the enhanced result, but only if self.image is currently set to a non-falsy value." adjust_brightness]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> factor </REF>: float "Brightness enhancement factor passed to ImageEnhance.Brightness.enhance(); values below 1.0 darken the image, 1.0 is neutral, and values above 1.0 brighten it"
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check whether self.image is truthy (non-None, non-empty image object) RESULT image_guard]
            [COMMAND If image_guard is True, construct a Brightness enhancer by wrapping self.image with ImageEnhance.Brightness RESULT enhancer]
            [COMMAND Call enhancer.enhance(factor) to produce the brightness-adjusted image and assign the result back to self.image, overwriting the original RESULT self.image]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: self.image is falsy (None, empty, or any other falsy value) when the method is called]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Skip all enhancer construction and image mutation; leave self.image unchanged and return without performing any operation RESULT no_op]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
